verdict.rationale: n8n's pricing page lists Git-based version control, and its docs include a source-control and environments page on pushing and pulling changes, so versioning workflows is supported. The pack never documents a review step (diffs or approvals) or how to roll back to an earlier workflow version, so those parts are at most implied by Git. Missing for 10: documented review/diff or approval flow for workflow changes, explicit rollback or restore-previous-version capability, clarity on which plans include Git version control, independent or hands-on corroboration.
